query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ebayListingsCache (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  cardId INT NOT NULL,
  searchQuery VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  listings JSON NOT NULL,
  hotExpiresAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  expiresAt TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE KEY unique_card_query (cardId, searchQuery),
  INDEX idx_card_id (cardId),
  INDEX idx_hot_expires (hotExpiresAt),
  INDEX idx_expires (expiresAt)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci;
